identifier.value: Jisr HR Human Capital Management System

product.name: Jisr HR Human Capital Management System
product.description: A cloud-based system for managing HR operations including hiring, onboarding, payroll, attendance, and compliance tailored for Saudi companies.

product.name: Jisr Payroll Management
product.description: A payroll solution that automates salary calculations, deductions, and payments while ensuring compliance with Saudi wage protection and labor laws.

product.name: Jisr Time and Attendance Tracking
product.description: A system to automate employee attendance, shift scheduling, and compliance with Saudi labor regulations.

product.name: Jisr Applicant Tracking System (ATS)
product.description: An integrated recruitment platform that automates job posting, candidate screening, interview scheduling, and hiring workflows.

product.name: Jisr Employee Performance Management
product.description: A system to manage employee evaluations, set objectives, and track performance using customizable assessment templates.

identifier.value: Jisr Business Travel and Expense Management

product.name: Jisr Business Travel and Expense Management
product.description: A platform to manage employee business travel requests, bookings, expense claims, and payments in one integrated system.
